$comment: GatorBait News, midweek edition for Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026 (Kentucky week). A news front built only from posts that are live on gatorbaitmedia.com: titles and bylines are the live posts' own (desk stories GatorBait Staff; Behind the Sticks by Brenden Martin). Records, rankings, schedule, results and tip/kickoff times: ESPN JSON pulled Nov. 10 (football team 57 schedule, event 401856884; AP Top 25 and Coaches Poll of Nov. 8 for football and Nov. 9 for men's basketball; men's and women's basketball team 57 schedules). Oklahoma numbers: ESPN box score, event 401856739. Quotes are verbatim from Jon Sumrall's Monday, Nov. 9 press conference transcript. Photos are each post's own cover image with the credit printed on that post; posts whose cover is a graphic or carries no credit run without art. No photo from the Sept. 26 Ole Miss game. Never name, link or credit Gator Country. The unpublished Buddy Martin Show recap and the LIVE NOW / HALFTIME posts are left out.

issue.week: Florida at No. 13 Kentucky · Saturday, 6:15 p.m. ET, ESPN

cover.headline: Sumrall's My Old Kentucky Home
cover.dek: Jon Sumrall played at Kentucky and coached there. He takes Florida (5-4, 3-4 SEC) to No. 13 Kentucky (7-2) on Saturday needing one more win for bowl eligibility. “This game's got very little to do about my ties to the place,” he said Monday.

image.alt: A fan in Kentucky blue stands in a crowd of fans dressed in orange and black. Photo courtesy University of Kentucky.

quotes.title: Sumrall on Kentucky week
quotes.dek: Jon Sumrall played at Kentucky and later coached there. From his Monday, Nov. 9, press conference.

items.text: This game's got very little to do about my ties to the place. It's about how do I get our team ready to play better and match really how they're playing, to be quite honest with you.
items.role: Florida coach, Monday press conference, Nov. 9

items.text: I wouldn't be where I'm at today if it weren't for the University of Kentucky.
items.role: Florida coach, on his time at Kentucky, Monday press conference, Nov. 9

items.text: It's maybe the best offensive line we've seen all year, and that's not just coach-speak; they're really good upfront offensively.
items.role: Florida coach, on Kentucky's offense, Monday press conference, Nov. 9

items.text: They're just sound. I think they play with a really high football IQ. They don't beat themselves.
items.role: Florida coach, on Kentucky's defense, Monday press conference, Nov. 9

items.text: Both practiced today. There'll be one guy that starts and one guy doesn't.
items.role: Florida coach, on his quarterbacks, Monday press conference, Nov. 9

items.text: I say this a lot to our guys: most games aren't won; they're lost.
items.role: Florida coach, Monday press conference, Nov. 9

wrap.title: Oklahoma 23, Florida 7
wrap.dek: Florida finished with 203 total yards to Oklahoma's 351 and did not score in the second half.

stats.label: Florida rushing yards
stats.detail: 25 carries at 2.8 yards each. Oklahoma ran for 144 on 40 carries.

stats.label: Florida third downs
stats.detail: Oklahoma converted 10 of 18 and held the ball 37:50 to Florida's 22:10.

stats.detail: Both were interceptions by Tramell Jones Jr. Oklahoma had none.
